data.desc: Anbio Biotechnology is a globally oriented in vitro diagnostics (IVD) company providing a broad range of solutions, including immunofluorescence, dry chemistry, chemiluminescence, molecular diagnostics, rapid testing and veterinary diagnostics. With operations across multiple regions, the company works to enhance the availability of reliable and timely diagnostics, supporting better decision-making in healthcare settings worldwide.
data.industry: Biotechnology: In Vitro & In Vivo Diagnostic Substances
